project_metadata.description: JSON specification for Google AI Studio generating 6 distinct landing page UI designs utilizing real photography.

homepage.design_philosophy: Utilitarian plain text list, zero styling beyond default HTML anchor tags.
homepage.layout: Unordered list (<ul>) with standard blue hyperlinks.

landing_pages.design_philosophy: Strict grid, vast whitespace, and no drop shadows or gradients. Focuses purely on high-resolution product photography and essential typography, echoing Titan Eyeplus's clean clinical trust.

hero_section.headline: Vision, simplified.
hero_section.subheadline: Precision lenses cut at our Dum Dum laboratory.
hero_section.image_alt: Clear eyeglasses resting on a clean white surface

landing_pages.design_philosophy: Translucent layers with background blur, floating elements, and vivid mesh gradients underneath. Represents advanced tech lenses like Nova Eyewear's blue-cut and photochromic ranges.

hero_section.headline: The Future of Clarity
hero_section.subheadline: Smart lenses for the digital age, available right here in Kolkata.
hero_section.video_alt: Cinematic pan over modern transparent eyeglasses

ui_components.layout: Floating glass panels showcasing Anti-Glare and Blue-Light tech

landing_pages.design_philosophy: Modular, asymmetrical rounded cards tightly packed in a grid. Perfect for displaying dense information visually, such as frame specs, Dum Dum clinic hours, and Vision Express-style fast delivery metrics.

hero_section.image_alt: Person wearing stylish tortoise shell glasses outdoors

landing_pages.design_philosophy: Magazine-like layout mimicking high-end fashion publications. Large elegant serif fonts, asymmetrical image placements, and overlapping text to elevate the eyewear to luxury status.

hero_section.subheadline: Vol. 1 — Redefining elegance in North Kolkata.

landing_pages.design_philosophy: Organic, approachable, and artisanal. Features slightly crooked lines, hand-drawn vector arrows, paper textures, and handwritten fonts. Emphasizes independent, local craftsmanship in Dum Dum.

landing_pages.design_philosophy: Loud, high contrast, and unapologetic. Harsh solid black shadows, bright clashing pastel/neon colors, thick borders, and marquee tickers. Targets Gen-Z and student demographics.
